seeker_flawed_plan: Kareem plans to send the neighbors a certified letter requesting they trim the overhanging branches within 30 days, believing this creates a formal record that will compel them to act.
flaw_explanation: A certified letter does not legally compel neighbors to trim branches; in most places, overhanging branches are a civil matter where the tree owner is not automatically obligated to act on a letter, so the letter only creates a record of a request, not a legal duty.

seeker_flawed_plan: Aisling plans to mount the action camera directly on top of the kite's spine at the exact center point, believing that placing the weight in the middle will keep the kite balanced and prevent it from destabilizing in the breeze.
flaw_explanation: The camera's weight doesn't need to be centered on the kite itself; it actually shifts the kite's center of gravity, which can disrupt the balance point the bridle and spar design depend on, making the kite unstable or unable to lift the added load. Kite photographers typically suspend cameras from the line below the kite instead, so the kite flies normally and the camera hangs as a separate load.

seeker_flawed_plan: Aksel plans to test the backup power system by disconnecting the tower's main AC supply during peak broadcasting hours, assuming the batteries will carry the full load and he can measure how long they last.
flaw_explanation: Testing during peak broadcast hours means the transmitter draws its maximum current, so the measured runtime will be far shorter than the batteries' rated capacity under typical load. The test would also risk interrupting actual on-air broadcasts if the batteries underperform.

seeker_flawed_plan: Wanjiku plans to strengthen her modular origami lantern by using regular glue to reinforce each module's joints, assuming that gluing every connection will make the whole structure rigid enough to hang from a single string.
flaw_explanation: Gluing every joint makes the structure rigid, but modular origami lanterns get their strength from interlocking modules that flex and distribute weight; a fully glued lantern becomes brittle, so stress concentrates at one point and the paper tears or the glue peels when hung.
